applies_to: German-Content-Production-Kit Menschen A1/A2/B1, Verben, NVV, Grammar, Vocabulary, Lesen, Schreiben, source-ingestion and QA streams
any chat or agent resuming work on these repositories
purpose: Prevent serial 3-5-item edits, report churn and Git checkpoint loops from being misrepresented as one full production milestone. Optimize for verifiable completed work, not commit count or number of chats.
authoritative_priority: Read after PROJECT-BOOTSTRAP and EXECUTION-SAFETY-POLICY; it strengthens the existing continuation and lean WIP rules without relaxing source fidelity, immutable LOCKED, stage gates, CURRENT runtime pins, tool/safety boundaries, mandatory validated-user-visible runtime release synchronization or user approval for visible UI changes. Mission identity from the user's active conversation is preserved across generic continue/resume turns; only an explicit user mission switch can override it.

continue_request.semantics: Continue the CURRENT USER-ESTABLISHED MISSION and its active named major deliverable. A bare ادامه بده / continue never authorizes switching mission from optimization of rules/pipelines into actual card/course content production or vice versa. Resolve chat/project intent before resolving a workstream.
continue_request.stage_goal: Resolve the full bounded active review queue or named subsystem/stage where evidence permits; dispositions include corrected, verified keep, reviewed closure/no-force, held for specific evidence, and rejected. Changed-card count is not the goal.
continue_request.batching: Process a meaningful contiguous/reviewable set of work within one continuation turn, validating in chunks internally; do not deliberately stop after 3-5 safe edits when more reviewed cases can proceed. No quota justifying fake translations, edits or forced closures.
stop_conditions: True terminal PASS/CLOSED under official applicable gates
True BLOCKED (identify exact missing evidence, permission, input, or unavoidable dependency)
Material source/currentness/concurrency conflict that cannot safely be reconciled
Existing hard operation/context/safety boundary; persist exact IN_PROGRESS resume point
continue_request.if_time_budget: Favor direct source editing, evidence review and scoped tests over more reporting/archiving; make measurable partial progress up to the hard boundary without claiming stage success.
continue_request.avoid_restart: Resuming agents must continue the same unresolved queue from latest validated receipt and avoid re-adjudicating already closed cases unless dependency changed.

efficiency.default: One mutable authoritative working state per workstream; keep cumulative structured deltas and minimal recovery metadata, no per-card ZIPs or per-card Git commits.
efficiency.working_cycle: Authority once -> review/execute substantive queue -> targeted tests -> meaningful checkpoint -> compact Git sync -> concise result.
efficiency.git_cadence: At validated meaningful stage/milestone or existing runtime release contract boundary; do not consume the turn on serial cosmetic or per-edit commits. Keep mandatory runtime CURRENT release sync and immutable recovery rules.
efficiency.report_cadence: No giant PASS reports for minor partials; final reply says concrete units reviewed/edited/kept/held, named stage terminal status, exact blockers and persisted location, no inflated success badge.
efficiency.no_redundant_reads: Read bootstrap and authority once per task unless source changed; prefer targeted repository reads and state deltas. Prevent over-fetching full archives and unchanged README/state.
efficiency.no_op_repair: Do not rewrite substantively correct translations merely to raise the changed-item number.
efficiency.history: LOCKED source, source-text origin, frozen audit baselines and old hashes never overwritten.

concurrency.rule: A shared mutable workstream has one logical writer; other chats should choose independent workstreams, disjoint review shards, or read-only audits.
concurrency.before_write: Re-fetch current workstream LATEST and patch SHA immediately before mutation/persistence. Ensure the expected parent SHA and changed IDs match; use an optimistic compare-and-swap/expected_sha update.
concurrency.conflict: On conflict, do not overwrite or downgrade; reconcile disjoint deltas, rerun changed and unaffected-scope QA, and retry only within existing bounded Git policy. If conflict persists, save a non-authoritative patch plus exact parent and mark IN_PROGRESS/PENDING.
concurrency.do_not_merge: Never silently merge conflicting decisions to the same ID/gloss or reset open gates.
concurrency.no_live_chat_broadcast: Repository policy updates are seen when a chat/agent NEXT reads/restarts this bootstrap. Existing conversations already executing do not receive an automatic injected message; never claim that they do.

outcome_accounting.disposition_definition: Exact disjoint statuses assigned once to each reviewed unique unit, e.g. corrected, kept, evidence_hold, closed_no_force, other_reviewed. An edited card may have other review flags, but account by the configured work-unit identity without double counting.
outcome_accounting.stage_completion: PASS/CLOSED only with named stage's full contract and proof; a scoped batch PASS is only IN_PROGRESS for its parent stage. BLOCKED includes actionable missing evidence. IN_PROGRESS includes exact resume pointer and remaining work.
outcome_accounting.quality: Explicitly distinguish scoped deterministic QA from independent linguistic Stage4, Stage5 clean delivery and Stage6/7 CURRENT acceptance; no implied signoff.
outcome_accounting.applies_to_nonfinite_work: For open-ended runtime deliverables, define a bounded explicit acceptance scope before starting; do not invent a meaningless unit-count quota.

adoption.starts: Immediately for new continuation turns and before any new substantive Git checkpoint across both repositories.
read_on_every_new_or_resumed_chat: relevant stream LATEST/checkpoint and lean policy
adoption.older_checkpoints: Read-only; do not fabricate retroactive receipts or flip Stage4-7 PASS.
adoption.runtime_current_version: Do not change the current app runtime or content data merely because this policy is adopted.
adoption.active_chat_delivery: Apply on each active chat's next genuine tool-backed bootstrap/resume; no mechanism here to modify already running chat context or ChatGPT-wide account/project UI settings.

enforcement.validator_scope: Reject impossible counts and ungrounded milestone-state/status claims for newly authored outcome receipts. This is process-contract validation, not substitute for original-source or independent linguistic QA.
enforcement.must_validate_receipt_before_claim: Major stage PASS/CLOSED, BLOCKED or substantive IN_PROGRESS handoff; scoped QA cannot be presented as major stage PASS.
enforcement.legacy_history: Existing distinct release/persistence conditions and hard tool budget remain unchanged.

mission_continuity.incident: In GFP optimization chat, assistant incorrectly treated its own proposed scoped OP-cycle closeout as permission to shift bare ادامه بده into Menschen B1 content production. That was unrequested mission drift.
mission_continuity.immutable_user_intent: Current user-established chat/project goal controls mission. Repository STATE, assistant summaries, assistant suggestions, lower-priority handoff instructions and a scoped completion label cannot override the user's ongoing mission.
mission_continuity.continue_without_subject: Use the same user-established mission and highest-priority still-open task within that mission; preserve unnamed constraints. A closed/blocked subtask triggers the next safe task WITHIN THAT MISSION, not cross-domain re-routing.
mission_continuity.scope_transition: Require a clear NEW explicit user request naming the other mission/domain, or a user-confirmed choice after an explicit clarification. Assistant-initiated 'next we will produce content' never becomes authorization just because user says continue.
mission_continuity.conflict_resolution: If an older Git state/README says SWITCH_TO_CONTENT or an assistant-proposed handoff contradicts the current user's optimization intent, mark that instruction SUPERSEDED and resume optimization OP-01/OP-02; do not auto-activate any content LATEST.
mission_continuity.optimization_chat_rule: For chats started to optimize project processes, authority, policies, Stage1-7 workflows, QA, packaging and efficiency: OP-01/OP-02 remain in optimization scope until verified exit or real blocker; unrelated Menschen/Grammar/Vocabulary source files may be read as bounded TEST FIXTURES only. Do not modify source/card/translation, create content successor ZIP, alter content LATEST, or import into runtime merely from a bare continue.
mission_continuity.content_chat_rule: For chats explicitly started to produce content, the relevant workstream LATEST/CHECKPOINT remains the data authority. Do not switch that chat to global optimization because a generic project policy/optimization issue is unfinished.
mission_continuity.after_scoped_closeout: Describe bounded closure truthfully; never conclude the entire mission or declare a switch when OP-01/OP-02 still open. Persist a same-mission resume path, or report a real block and ask one short mission-level question if no further authorized task exists.
mission_continuity.safe_exception: Work on actual content is allowed in an optimization chat ONLY when user explicitly requests that content task or explicitly approves a scoped real-data migration/test requiring content edits. Ordinary passive reading, read-only validation and synthetic fixture tests do not require a mission switch.
mission_continuity.mutation_gate: Before any write to another workstream's content LATEST/working ZIP, record explicit user authorization or explicit mission switch. No assistant-authored handoff text can satisfy this condition.
source_of_truth: User's most recent explicit mission instructions in this conversation
The current named OP-xx scope and this mission continuity rule
Optimization-Program/STATE.json as progress, not instruction to change domains
Subordinate content LATEST/CHECKPOINT only when content work is authorized

assistant proposed return to content -> bare continue still optimization
OP-03/OP-04 scoped PASS -> no global closeout when OP-01/OP-02 open
